towers.name: Bolt Turret
towers.desc: Homing single shots at a steady rate. The all-rounder; its tree picks a job.

coreBoon.text: Next to the Core: every shot passes into one more body.

choices.name: Marksman
choices.desc: Reach: +2.5 range. Covers more road from the same cell.

choices.name: Gatling
choices.desc: Throughput: fires twice as often, -1 range. More shots at fewer cells.

choices.name: Piercing
choices.desc: Each shot passes through its target into up to 2 more enemies behind it. The answer to a column.

choices.name: Shatter
choices.desc: Double damage to shields. The answer to shellbacks.

choices.name: Railbore
choices.desc: One massive round: +22 damage, and armour does nothing against it. The answer to brutes.

choices.name: Hailstorm
choices.desc: Three homing shots per volley at full damage, each at a different enemy when there is one - but the reach drops to close quarters. Point-blank saturation: the answer to a crowd at the choke.

towers.name: Mortar
towers.desc: Lobs a shell at a place and blasts what stands there. Cannot hit its own feet.

coreBoon.text: Next to the Core: no dead zone - it can hit its own feet.

choices.name: Shaped Charge
choices.desc: Focused payload: +12 damage in a blast 0.3 cells smaller. Kills the few.

choices.name: Wide Burst
choices.desc: Wider blast: +0.6 cells of radius at 85% damage. Wounds the many.

choices.name: Long Barrel
choices.desc: Reach: +2 range, but the dead zone grows by 1. Sit it back from the road.

choices.name: Short Fuse
choices.desc: Close work: the dead zone shrinks by 1.5, range -1. Sit it right on the road.

choices.name: Concussive
choices.desc: The blast slows everything it hits to 60% for a second. Control, not just damage.

choices.name: Cluster
choices.desc: Three shells per volley at 60% damage each, scattered around the aim point. Saturation.

towers.name: Refinery
towers.desc: Mines the ore vein under it. Builds nothing, shoots nothing, pays for everything.

coreBoon.text: Next to the Core: mines from nothing - 1 Ore a cycle with no vein, forever.

choices.name: Wide Bore
choices.desc: 2 Ore per cycle, but a cycle takes 60 s instead of 40. More Ore sooner; the vein empties sooner.

choices.name: Deep Bore
choices.desc: The vein under it grows by half, and every cycle takes 60 s. Less now, more in the end - for the patient.

choices.name: Survey
choices.desc: Every Survey refinery speeds up ALL rock-breaking jobs, everywhere.

choices.name: Automation
choices.desc: Prospects nearby rocks by itself, free, one job at a time.

choices.name: Mother Lode
choices.desc: +2 Ore per cycle. The vein pays out fast and runs dry fast.

choices.name: Deep Shaft
choices.desc: The vein under it doubles, and every cycle takes 40 s longer. The long game - only if you can hold this ground.

towers.name: Frost Emitter
towers.desc: A cold field around it slows everything inside. Slows from different sources stack: the coldest wins, the longest lasts.

coreBoon.text: Next to the Core: every third pulse freezes the field solid.

choices.name: Deep Chill
choices.desc: Colder: slowed enemies move at 40% instead of 55%, for 10 ticks longer. The slow path.

choices.name: Ice Shards
choices.desc: The field cuts: +4 damage per pulse to everything inside it. The damage path.

choices.name: Wide Field
choices.desc: Bigger field: +1.5 range to the chill. More road under the slow.

choices.name: Brittle
choices.desc: This field's pulses deal +50% to anything already slowed. Chill first, then cut.

choices.name: Absolute Zero
choices.desc: Every fourth pulse freezes the field solid: enemies stop dead for the slow's duration.

choices.name: Shatterfield
choices.desc: +14 damage per pulse. The field becomes a weapon.

towers.name: Tesla Coil
towers.desc: An arc that jumps body to body through a pack. Short reach, answers crowds.

coreBoon.text: Next to the Core: every arc hits two more bodies.

choices.name: Long Arc
choices.desc: Reach: +1.5 range. The first arc finds bodies further out.

choices.name: Twin Coil
choices.desc: Throughput: arcs every 12 ticks instead of 20. More arcs, the same bite.

choices.name: Forked
choices.desc: Every arc hits two more bodies. The answer to a column.

choices.name: Grounding
choices.desc: Bodies the arc touches slow to 60% for 15 ticks. Control on a chain.

choices.name: Overload
choices.desc: +16 damage on the first hop, and every hop after it. The answer to brutes.

choices.name: Conductor
choices.desc: Three more bodies per arc, hops span two more cells, at 80% damage. The answer to swarms.

towers.name: Missile Rack
towers.desc: Slow, heavy homing missiles that explode on arrival. Long reach, a dead zone.

coreBoon.text: Next to the Core: two missiles per launch.

choices.name: Warhead
choices.desc: +20 damage per missile. Kills the one it was sent for.

choices.name: Seeker
choices.desc: Reach: +2 range, and a missile every 50 ticks instead of 60.

choices.name: Salvo
choices.desc: Two missiles per launch at 75% damage, each homing on a different enemy when there is one.

choices.name: Fragmentation
choices.desc: Blast +0.6 cells at 85% damage. Wounds the many.

choices.name: Bunker Buster
choices.desc: +40 damage, and armour does nothing against it. The answer to a Juggernaut.

choices.name: Barrage
choices.desc: Three missiles per launch at 60% damage each. Saturation from range.

towers.name: Laser Lance
towers.desc: A beam down the road it faces to where the road turns, however far that is, through every body on it: a pulse a second, and the damage climbs while it holds one. R rotates it.

coreBoon.text: Next to the Core: the heat climbs one multiple higher.

choices.name: Capacitor
choices.desc: +14 damage per pulse, cold or hot. The damage path starts steady.

choices.name: Chill
choices.desc: Every body in the beam moves at 70% while it stands in it; a pulse a second keeps it cold. The control path starts cold.

choices.name: Fast Cycle
choices.desc: A pulse every 13 ticks instead of 20: half again the output.

choices.name: Sear
choices.desc: Bodies leave the beam burning: 2 a tick for a second. The beam keeps hurting after they pass.

choices.name: Cutter
choices.desc: Every pulse at 150% and the heat climbs one multiple higher. The answer to a column standing in the beam.

choices.name: Deep Sear
choices.desc: The burn doubles and lasts two seconds; the chill deepens to 50%. Nothing walks out of this beam unmarked.

towers.name: Bastion
towers.desc: Shoots nothing. The four towers in its plus hit harder; its tree makes the arms longer and the gift bigger.

coreBoon.text: Next to the Core: the plus reaches one cell further.

choices.name: Command
choices.desc: Neighbours hit for 30% more instead of 15%.

choices.name: Logistics
choices.desc: Neighbours fire 15% faster, and producers cycle 15% faster.

choices.name: Reach
choices.desc: The arms grow to two cells: eight neighbours instead of four.

choices.name: Hardpoint
choices.desc: Neighbours gain +1 range.

choices.name: Warlord
choices.desc: Neighbours hit for 30% more on top of everything.

choices.name: Quartermaster
choices.desc: Neighbouring producers cycle 50% faster; neighbours gain +1 range.
